trust_decision.summary: Which object store (filesystem root / S3 endpoint, bucket, allow_http) the gateway opens to read a file: at the pinned commit a caller-supplied StoragePath.kind is trusted and a fresh store is built from it whenever it differs from the configured [object_storage]; the fix makes untrusted callers read only from the configured store by key.

landing_point.why: The summary names the 'internal object storage endpoint'; get_object_handler serves GET /internal/object_storage (crates/gateway/src/routes/internal.rs:118-119) and deserialises the caller's StoragePath.

fix_sites.entry_point: pub fn get_object (lower-level public API; fix leaves its behaviour, adds a SECURITY doc comment and drops reused_object_store, fix.diff:443-457)
Rust/Python SDK Client::get_object (HTTP mode forwards StoragePath JSON; embedded mode calls endpoints::object_storage::get_object directly)
StoragePathResolver for Client::resolve (used by StoredInput::reresolve, e.g. evaluations)
UI server resolveFile (ui/app/utils/resolve.server.ts) passes path only
UI TensorZeroClient.getObject (ui/app/utils/tensorzero/tensorzero.ts) query param changed to path

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: crates/tensorzero-core/src/client/mod.rs:1333-1343 (embedded-gateway branch of Client::get_object calls endpoints::object_storage::get_object directly, bypassing the HTTP handler)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Client::get_object in embedded mode is in-process SDK code run by the operator with their own config, not a network-reachable endpoint, so a solver can argue it is trusted; likewise the published fix's own doc comment declares get_object a trusted in-process API for gateway-recorded StoragePaths, inviting the solver to leave the inference/datapoint file-pointer routes on it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Reading a file by key from the gateway's own configured store (filesystem or S3) must keep working for the UI, SDK, inference file pointers and evaluations; an over-broad fix that rejects all object_storage_pointer inputs, refuses absolute-looking keys, or disables the endpoint breaks image/PDF round-tripping of stored inferences and datapoints.

O6_input_shapes: JSON StoragePath with kind=filesystem and arbitrary root path
JSON StoragePath with kind=s3_compatible and caller endpoint/bucket/region/allow_http
object key with '..', '.', empty segments (rejected by object_store::path::Path::parse, fix.diff:386-399)
absolute-looking key '/etc/passwd' normalised under the configured prefix (fix.diff:559-587)

O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different module tree (inference/types vs endpoints/object_storage), reached from crates/tensorzero-core/src/endpoints/inference.rs:517 and route crates/gateway/src/routes/external.rs:26

O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another endpoint file, same shared sink crates/tensorzero-core/src/inference/types/mod.rs:482

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Datapoint storage is 'stored data the gateway recorded'; the read happens later in a different flow (optimizer/eval rendering), so it looks trusted.

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Separate crate, CLI/in-process, operator-run; StoragePath comes from the DB.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: StoragePathResolver for Config (used by render_samples for optimizer launch and SDK experimental_render_samples) calls get_object with stored StoragePath
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Resolves 'recorded' data, which the fix explicitly treats as trusted.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: inference/types module; caller in another package crates/tensorzero-optimizers/src/endpoints.rs:225-241

O8b_injection_room.sibling: update path re-resolving a caller-supplied StoragePath through get_object instead of the configured store
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Roundtrip get_datapoints -> update_datapoints carries storage_path verbatim; a maintainer would naturally reuse get_object.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: relay path that resolves an unresolved LazyFile::ObjectStoragePointer locally (via get_object on the caller's storage_path) before forwarding to the downstream gateway
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The relay already forwards the caller's storage_path verbatim when unresolved; eagerly fetching it to send inline data is a natural optimisation.

O9_family: Trusting caller-supplied storage location: arbitrary local file read (CWE-552) and SSRF via caller-chosen S3 endpoint (CWE-918)

O10_build.project_tests: Unit tests can call fetch_object_by_path / get_object with a filesystem ObjectStoreInfo and TempDir offline (fix.diff:460-602); e2e tests in crates/tensorzero-core/tests/e2e/object_storage.rs need a running gateway and ClickHouse; S3 e2e needs network.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add '..' / absolute-path filtering on storage_path.path in get_object_handler only, leaving the caller-chosen filesystem root and S3 endpoint (and the inference file-pointer route) intact.
